releaseNotes:
Hubble 1.0.2

Hubble 1.0.2: automatic updates are ready

Hubble checks the public signed update feed every 30 minutes and offers Check for Updates. HubDash shows an Update control and prompts once per Hubble launch when a newer version is available. Accepted updates install notarized Hubble and HubDash together.\n\nThis release also adopts the stable Node-API SQLite runtime to prevent worker-shutdown crashes.
